note: Outside forecasts of when AGI arrives, plotted against our strict-AGI curve. None uses our exact definition. Each entry's bar says how it compares: announcement (measures an announcement, not whether a system exists), narrower (an easier milestone, so an early bound), stricter (a harder milestone, so a late bound), different (a different test) or own-definition (the forecaster's own, unstated bar); gap says how in one line. A median is plotted as a 50% point at that date. Market prices come from the market's public API, dated in Pacific time.

forecasts.what: Any company announces AGI before Apr 1, 2027
forecasts.definition: Any company (including small private ones with major-press coverage) explicitly announcing it has achieved AGI; its rules exclude AGI-era/AGI-like remarks. Not our strict bar. Spiked briefly after GPT-6 Astra (closes of 65% on Sept 4 and 62% on Sept 7, intraday high 84%); 24–34% since Sept 17.
forecasts.gap: Measures an announcement, not the existence of a strict-bar system.
forecasts.rating: market price (Kalshi API last trade; thin market)

forecasts.definition: Automated coder: narrower than our bar (coding only), so an early bound
forecasts.gap: Coding only, so it should arrive before our bar.

forecasts.definition: Top-expert-dominating AI: as good as top experts at virtually all cognitive tasks; stricter than our bar, so a late bound
forecasts.gap: Top-expert level on virtually all cognitive tasks, so it should arrive after our bar.

forecasts.definition: DeepMind's own definition; point estimate "2029 or 2030", no probability given; plotted at 50% as an approximation
forecasts.gap: His own definition and a two-year point estimate, not a probability.

forecasts.what: First general AI system, community median
forecasts.definition: Metaculus general-AI question: requires a public announcement plus robotics and an adversarial Turing test; stricter on robotics, can't resolve on a hidden system.
forecasts.gap: Adds robotics and needs a public announcement, so it can never count a hidden system.
forecasts.rating: forecast aggregate (Metaculus community prediction, read on metaculus.com; about 1.9k forecasters; middle half 2 Apr 2028 to Apr 2037)
